home.eyebrow: A personal way to get dressed
home.introText: A considered wardrobe can reflect who you are today and give you room to become. Together, we explore the colours, shapes and pieces that feel like yours.
home.featuredText: Begin with a conversation, a fresh look at your wardrobe or a new direction for what comes next.
home.approachText: Styling is a personal process. We notice what feels right, refine what does not and build a wardrobe that makes everyday choices easier.
home.pjText: Thoughtful pieces for the hours you keep for yourself.
home.socialText: Find new ideas, behind the scenes moments and a little more of Doina's world.

style-discovery.title: Personal Style Discovery
style-discovery.short: Find the colours, shapes and combinations that feel like you.
style-discovery.full: A thoughtful starting point for defining a style that reflects your life and personality.
style-discovery.for: You want a clearer sense of your style or are entering a new chapter.
includes: A tailored direction to take forward
style-discovery.process: We begin with your goals, explore your preferences and finish with practical recommendations.

wardrobe-edit.title: The Wardrobe Edit
wardrobe-edit.short: Make more of what you already own.
wardrobe-edit.full: A focused review of your wardrobe to reveal useful combinations and identify what is missing.
wardrobe-edit.for: Getting dressed feels harder than it should, even with a full wardrobe.
wardrobe-edit.process: We review your pieces together, create outfits and make a plan for what stays, changes or goes.

colour-direction.title: Colour Direction
colour-direction.short: Discover a palette that brings your wardrobe together.
colour-direction.full: An introduction to the colours and contrasts that help you feel at ease and look like yourself.
colour-direction.for: You want more confidence choosing colours and building combinations.
colour-direction.process: We explore colour against your features and preferences, then translate it into everyday choices.

shopping-together.title: Shopping Together
shopping-together.short: Shop with purpose and leave with pieces you will wear.
shopping-together.full: Guided shopping built around your needs, budget and the wardrobe you already have.
shopping-together.for: You need a few strong pieces and a more confident way to shop.
shopping-together.process: We agree on priorities before the session, then shop and style selections together.

about.title: About Doina
about.intro: Personal style is a way of feeling more at home in yourself.
about.story: Doina works at the meeting point of personal styling and design. This biography is a placeholder until her own story and professional background are provided.
about.philosophy: The most meaningful style does not ask you to become someone else. It helps you notice what already feels true and express it with intention.
about.work: We start by listening. From there, we explore your routines, preferences and ambitions, then turn those insights into practical choices you can live in.
about.design: Design brings another dimension to Doina's work: attention to fabric, proportion and the feeling of a piece on the body.
